description: This file defines unit testing structures and classes for PKITS tests related to certificate path validation, including test info configuration and a parameterized test class. It includes external dependencies on test helpers, DER parsing, and Google Test framework.

classes.name: PkitsTestInfo
classes.description: Struct holding test configuration parameters for PKITS tests, including policies, test number, and expected outcomes.

classes.name: PkitsTest
classes.description: Template class for running parameterized PKITS tests with delegate-defined test execution logic.

methods.name: SetInitialPolicySet
methods.description: Sets the initial policy set for the test.

methods.name: SetUserConstrainedPolicySet
methods.description: Sets the user-constrained policy set for the test.

methods.name: SetInitialExplicitPolicy
methods.description: Sets the initial explicit policy flag.

methods.name: SetInitialPolicyMappingInhibit
methods.description: Sets the initial policy mapping inhibit flag.

methods.name: SetInitialInhibitAnyPolicy
methods.description: Sets the initial inhibit any policy flag.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Runs a PKITS test with specified certificate and CRL names and test info, adjusting expectations based on test number.
